body:
Hi! Here is what i found about this bug.

**Tested on:** Windows 11 Pro 25H2, Godot 4.6.3-stable and 4.8.dev (custom build, b13043816)
**Renderers:** Forward+, Mobile and Compatibility
**Hardware:** NVIDIA RTX 4080 Laptop GPU (driver 32.0.16.1714), single monitor

**Result:** Can't reproduce on Windows. With a terminal focused (typing into it), hovering over different folders in the editor's FileSystem dock updates the tooltip as expected.

**Notes:** I discussed this with Claude AI, which suggested it may be specific to how the X11 display server handles mouse events when the window isn't focused, since X11 and Wayland handle input events differently.

This is my first time testing an issue here, so any feedback on how I report things is welcome! :)))))

### Tested versions
 
 Reproducible in: 4.7.2 (stable), 4.6.2(stable)
 ### System information
 
 Godot v4.7.2.stable - Linux Mint 22.2 (Zara) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon Graphics (radeonsi, renoir, ACO, DRM 3.64, 7.0.0-34-generic) - AMD Ryzen 7 4800H with Radeon Graphics (16 threads) - 14.98 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Result
I was able to replicate the issue on 4.6.2, though i believed, there is a chance it would have been fixed in subsequent updates, however, upon updating to 4.7.2, the result is the same, I am new to contributing, so I do not know if videos of the bugs are acceptable, but i am still attaching the file, of the issue being present in the 4.7.2 version of the editor. I understand if this gets taken down, as I still am getting used to the contributor workflow.
